results.name: Admin login shows dashboard stats (9 books, 3 issued, 3 members, 1 overdue)
Admin sees 6 menu items; CSV export visible
Add book with price appears in inventory; bad ISBN rejected
Issue book reduces availability and raises issued count
Same member cannot borrow the same book twice
Issue blocked when no copies are available (Clean Code: 2/2 out)
Returning the 15-day-overdue loan charges Rs 150 and logs it in Fines
Waived fine is tracked separately from collected fine
XSS: script payload in book title is rendered as text, not executed
CSV export contains header and transaction rows
Staff cannot delete a book that is currently on loan
Member directory: duplicate email blocked
Login brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts
Librarian sees 5 items and no Member Directory
Admin uploads 15-page PDF to a book; oversize (>12 MB) and fake PDFs rejected
Reader self-registration: wrong OTP rejected, correct OTP creates member MEM-104
Reader logs in by Member ID and sees 5 reader menu items
Free preview PDF contains exactly 7 of 15 pages
Download is blocked without subscription or purchase
Buying a book adds it to My Library as Owned and logs Rs 99 payment; full 15 pages readable
Monthly subscription (Rs 149) activates for 30 days
Hold request for a fully-loaned book is created and can be cancelled
Wishlist add and remove
Expired subscription falls back to preview mode
Password change works and old password stops working
Data and session persist across page reload
Dark theme toggle persists after reload
Sidebar items are keyboard-focusable
Enter key activates a sidebar item
Toast is an aria-live status region
Modals expose role=dialog and aria-modal
Escape closes an open modal
Password visibility toggles have accessible names
Clickable table rows are keyboard-focusable
No uncaught JavaScript errors during the whole run
